page_title: FUL 1-1 WHU | Fulham v West Ham 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Tim Robinson is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' 1 - 1 Goal! Jarrod Bowen tees up Danny Ings (West Ham) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 1:1.

90+4' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post.
90+4' Now West Ham have a corner.
90+2' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) is punished with the yellow card.
90+2' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and signals a foul after Carlos Soler (West Ham) brought his opponent down.
89' The attendance for today's match is 26528.
86' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Harrison Reed (Fulham) replacing Andreas Pereira.
85' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
82' Here's the change. Edson Alvarez leaves the pitch and Danny Ings (West Ham) comes on as a substitute.
82' Carlos Soler (West Ham) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Tim Robinson didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for West Ham.
80' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Adama Traore (Fulham) who loops his header high over the bar.
80' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
79' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
74' Tim Robinson shows the yellow card to Edson Alvarez (West Ham) for a heavy challenge.
73' It's time for a substitution. Tom Cairney (Fulham) comes on in place of Emile Smith Rowe.
73' Here is a change. Raul Jimenez is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
72' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) runs onto a good ball played into the box and hits a first-time screamer towards goal, but a defender somehow gets his body in the way and makes the block.
70' Substitution. Carlos Soler (West Ham) has come on for Guido Rodriguez.
69' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) is given a yellow card.
66' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Sander Berge (Fulham) replaces Alex Iwobi.
66' That's the end of the game for Sasa Lukic, who is replaced by Reiss Nelson (Fulham).
64' What a beautiful long-range strike by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar.

60' A nice lofted cross finds Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) unmarked and he displays an excellent touch to control the ball. Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) drills a low shot towards the middle of the net, but doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. An easy save.
58' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tim Robinson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
57' The game has come to an end for Emerson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Vladimir Coufal (West Ham).
54' The free kick is taken by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham), but ball is cleared.
53' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) has tested the patience of referee Tim Robinson and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
51' Emerson (West Ham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
50' Emerson (West Ham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
50' The linesman raises his flag. Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is adjudged offside.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Julen Lopetegui probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Michail Antonio. He is replaced by Crysencio Summerville (West Ham).
46' Half-time substitution. Tomas Soucek will not participate anymore and Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is coming on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fulham comes to nothing.
45+2' Adama Traore (Fulham) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
40' Emerson (West Ham) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
39' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
36' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
33' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar.
32' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
32' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
28' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Raul Jimenez (Fulham) heads on.
24' 1 - 0 What a goal! Emile Smith Rowe plays it to Raul Jimenez (Fulham), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Alphonse Areola into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
23' Alex Iwobi swings the cross over. Adama Traore (Fulham) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the left post.
20' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
20' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball goes out for a corner. Fulham can continue in their attacking effort.
19' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
17' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
16' Referee Tim Robinson halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Marco Silva, then shows him a yellow.
16' Adama Traore (Fulham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
15' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by West Ham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
12' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.

8' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Alphonse Areola!
7' Poor challenge! Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is penalised for tripping and Tim Robinson blows his whistle.
6' Michail Antonio (West Ham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
5' A short through ball almost allows Tomas Soucek (West Ham) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
2' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends it out of play.

1' Adama Traore (Fulham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! West Ham will take the kick-off.
Tim Robinson got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
